text:
elaine: FYI billing alerted to org-level billing bumps after 00:00 deploy. quick triage shows auth-introspect timeouts caused proxy to collapse origin to org-only.
ben: timeline? which service rolled?
elaine: auth-proxy v2.1 at 2025-11-07T23:58Z. spike started 00:03Z. edge logs show `x-origin: org/900` but original inbound had `x-original-origin: org/900/project/42/sa/batch`
raj: collapsing was intentional for safety but we didn't account for billing/quotas.
ops-bot: auth-proxy v2.1 deployed -> rollout 100% at 00:01Z.
billing: org/900 tokens +11% and project/42 -11%. accounts flagged it.
ben: mitigation ideas: (1) preserve original header but mark `x-origin-asserted: false`, (2) HMAC-sign preserved header, (3) add telemetry tag `auth.origin_resolution=introspect_timeout_preserved`.
elaine: vote for preserve+asserted flag+signature. downstream services MUST ignore unsigned preserved headers for auth decisions.
raj: add console toggles: per-account "require asserted project attribution" (reject uncertain attribution) and a dashboard filter for `auth.origin_resolution`. devex: we can add a small badge "attribution uncertain (n)" and trace links.
devex: will add `attribution_uncertain_count` column and filter by `auth.origin_resolution`.
billing: rule: prefer most-specific asserted identity; if none, bill org and increment `billing.attribution_uncertain`. finance will review corrections; no automatic invoice changes.
raj: security: only accept signed preserved headers or from trusted CIDR. I'll add HMAC signing, key rotation plan and a feature flag `preserve_signed_origin_on_introspect_fail`.
elaine: rollout: small hotfix to preserve+sign headers -> staging smoke -> 5% canary -> monitor billing signals -> full roll. also add backfill to find affected windows.
ben: I'll open the PR tonight and include unit + e2e tests that simulate introspect 5xx/504 and validate preserved signed header + telemetry.
ops-bot: checklist created.
elaine: thanks all. will coordinate with accounts for customer notices if backfill shows non-trivial impact.
